meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一篇文章或一个选题,变成图文并茂的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有文字稿或选题,想快速做成能直接发布的解说视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn an article or topic into a graphics-and-text explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a script or topic and want a publishable explainer video fast

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把一段文字(文章、笔记、主题或 brief)做成无真人出镜的解说视频:它挑选设计系统、逐帧规划教学故事、生成旁白和背景音乐,最后渲染出成片视频文件。
howto.when: 当你给出一段文字(文章、笔记、主题等),要做概念解说、how-to 或清单类视频时触发;若视频基于网站,或意图不明确,会先转去 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这篇关于复利的文章做成解说视频
say.note: 会先出逐帧方案让你确认

say.text: 用男声给这个 how-to 主题配旁白
say.note: 会挑对应男声并生成音频

say.text: 换个设计预设重做这个视频的视觉
say.note: 会重跑设计系统这一步

howto.what_en: Claude turns text (an article, notes, a topic, or a brief) into a faceless explainer video: it picks a design system, plans a frame-by-frame story, generates narration and music, and renders a final mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give text (an article, notes, a topic, etc.) for a concept explainer, how-to, or listicle video; website-based videos or unclear intent route to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into an explainer video
say_en.note: You review and approve the frame plan first.

say_en.text: Use a male voice for the narration on this how-to topic
say_en.note: It picks a matching voice id and generates audio.

say_en.text: Redo the visuals with a different design preset
say_en.note: It reruns the design system step.
